content: Tutorial: How to Build an AI Agent Workflow with Camunda How do you build an AI agent workflow that integrates human-in-the-loop and REST calls? Camunda Process Alchemist and Technical Evangelist Niall Deehan is here to show you how, using Camunda 8.8.0-alpha8 and BPMN (Business Process Model and Notation). In this tutorial, Niall uses Camunda 8.8.0-alpha8 and BPMN.
